title: Baa Juice Sour Blue Raspberry Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Sour Blue Raspberry Shortfill packs a bold, tangy hit. Blue Raspberry delivers its distinctive mix of sweet and tart notes, sharpened further with a sour edge that adds extra bite. This lively flavour is balanced by the smooth vapour production of its high-VG base, making it a standout choice for fruit lovers. Supplied in a 120ml bottle with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, there’s space for two nic shots if required. Blended at 50/50 ratio, this Shortfill is designed for MTL pod kits to produce a balanced vaping style with vibrant flavour. Baa Juice Shortfills use double-concentrated flavouring for an impactful flavour experience that stays strong throughout the day.
